q-1883.name: Question 1
q-1883.worked_solution:
We take the derivative of each term and then add them, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(3{x}^{-2}+\operatorname{cos}⁡x-3\operatorname{sec}⁡x) \\  & =-2\cdot 3{x}^{-3}+(-\operatorname{sin}⁡x)-3\operatorname{sec}⁡x\operatorname{tan}⁡x \\  & =-6{x}^{-3}-\operatorname{sin}⁡x-3\operatorname{sec}⁡x\operatorname{tan}⁡x \\  & =-\frac{6}{{x}^{3}}-\operatorname{sin}⁡x-3\operatorname{sec}⁡x\operatorname{tan}⁡x\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

q-1883.html:
Question 1
?

Calculate dydx if y=3x2+cos⁡x−3sec⁡x.

a
6x−1−sin⁡x−3sec⁡xtan⁡x
b
−6x−3+sin⁡x−3sec⁡xtan⁡x
c
−6x3−sin⁡x−3sec⁡xtan⁡x
d
6x−3−sin⁡x−3sec⁡xtan⁡x
e
−6x−1−sin⁡x−3sec⁡xtan⁡x
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We take the derivative of each term and then add them, as follows:

dydx=ddx(3x−2+cos⁡x−3sec⁡x)=−2⋅3x−3+(−sin⁡x)−3sec⁡xtan⁡x=−6x−3−sin⁡x−3sec⁡xtan⁡x=−6x3−sin⁡x−3sec⁡xtan⁡x

q-1913.name: Question 2
q-1913.worked_solution:
We calculate the derivative using the product rule, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(-2{x}^{4}\operatorname{cot}⁡x) \\  & =(-8{x}^{3})(\operatorname{cot}⁡x)+(-2{x}^{4})(-{csc}^{2}⁡x) \\  & =-8{x}^{3}\operatorname{cot}⁡x+2{x}^{4}{csc}^{2}⁡x\end{aligned}\end{aligned}

q-1913.html:
Question 2
?

Find dydx if y=−2x4cot⁡x.

a
2x4csc2⁡x−8x3cot⁡x
b
2x4cot2⁡x−8x3csc⁡x
c
2x2csc⁡x−8x3cot⁡x
d
2x4csc2⁡x+8x3tan⁡x
e
x4csc2⁡x+8x3cot⁡x
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We calculate the derivative using the product rule, as follows:

dydx=ddx(−2x4cot⁡x)=(−8x3)(cot⁡x)+(−2x4)(−csc2⁡x)=−8x3cot⁡x+2x4csc2⁡x

q-31354.name: Question 3
q-31354.worked_solution:
We calculate the derivative using the product rule, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{csc}⁡x\operatorname{cot}⁡x) \\  & =(-\operatorname{csc}⁡x\operatorname{cot}⁡x)\cdot \operatorname{cot}⁡x+\operatorname{csc}⁡x\cdot (-{csc}^{2}⁡x) \\  & =-\operatorname{csc}⁡x{cot}^{2}⁡x-{csc}^{3}⁡x\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Question 3
?

Find f′(x) if f(x)=csc⁡xcot⁡x.

a
−csc⁡xcot⁡x−csc3⁡x
b
csc⁡xcot2⁡x−csc3⁡x
c
−csc⁡xcot2⁡x−csc3⁡x
d
−csc⁡xcot2⁡x+csc2⁡x
e
csc⁡xcot⁡x−csc3⁡x
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

We calculate the derivative using the product rule, as follows:

f′(x)=ddx(csc⁡xcot⁡x)=(−csc⁡xcot⁡x)⋅cot⁡x+csc⁡x⋅(−csc2⁡x)=−csc⁡xcot2⁡x−csc3⁡x
